headline: Troubled Rural Banks (BPR) Can Be Injected With Capital and Revived, DPR Proposes to LPS
summary: The chairman of Indonesia's House Commission XI urged the deposit insurer LPS to focus on recapitalizing problematic BPR rural banks. He said this could attract new investors and support small businesses.
why: LPS is Indonesia's deposit insurance agency, which resolves and supports failing banks. BPR rural banks serve small businesses and households, so their rescue affects local credit access.
original_headline: BPR Sakit Bisa Disuntik Modal dan Dihidupkan Lagi, Ini Usul DPR ke LPS
